tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Inspect tools/backends. check_native=true runs jy-draftc self-check; existence alone is not native acceptance.

tools.name: probe_media
tools.description: Probe a local source (absolute path or relative to the first media root), including SHA-256 and streams.

tools.name: list_native_projects
tools.description: List real Jianying desktop drafts and exact local:// refs. Separate from list_projects (service-created projects).

tools.name: get_native_draft
tools.description: Read an existing native project's saved main timeline, including encrypted drafts. Returns exact segment IDs, integer-microsecond ranges and content hash; does not edit or save.

tools.name: get_native_clip
tools.description: Inspect one saved native segment, its raw settings, referenced materials (including text/curves/effects), missing references and content hash. Times are integer microseconds; no media files are opened.

tools.name: list_native_operations
tools.description: List native edit receipts newest-first, including failed/uncertain copies. A started receipt is not proof a worker is alive. Query before retrying a timed-out edit.

tools.name: get_native_operation
tools.description: Read a durable native edit receipt, completed command count, output_ref, verification status and original native errors. Does not retry, delete, open or repair anything.

tools.name: remove_native_clip
tools.description: Remove a saved native segment in a NEW project copy. ripple=true shifts only subsequent clips on the same track by the removed duration; other tracks are not synchronized. Verifies all surviving segments/materials; magnetic main-track normalizations that disagree with saved ranges are rejected. Failure retains an unverified copy and receipt, never changes the source.

tools.name: set_native_clip_speed
tools.description: Set native video speed in a NEW project copy. Choose exactly one: constant speed, named curve or custom points (normalized source x=0..1, speed multiplier y=0.01..100, strictly ordered endpoints 0 and 1). Keeps source range/start; no ripple. Overlaps or unrelated changes are rejected by readback. Curve serialization is not rendered-motion acceptance.

tools.name: add_native_subtitles
tools.description: Add explicit sentence-level subtitle cues to a NEW native project copy. Each cue has text/start/duration in timeline SECONDS. Cues must not overlap; vendor selects subtitle track(s). Verifies saved text, ranges and existing content. This is not ASR. Batch failure leaves only an unverified copy, not a partially accepted result; inspect the receipt before retrying.

tools.name: split_native_clip
tools.description: Split an existing encrypted/native draft through vendor lyra-cli. ALWAYS duplicates into a new native project first; source is never patched. points are SECONDS relative to the segment, or timeline-absolute with absolute=true, strictly inside. Use seg_id/hash from get_native_draft or current-project read. Returns original/new IDs, exact saved ranges, output_ref/path and catalog warnings. It does not open/reload the UI or export video; do not retry blindly after an uncertain result.

tools.name: prepare_native_copy
tools.description: After fully exiting Jianying, prepare a successful native edit copy for opening. Repairs only that receipt-proven copy's project identity and root content mirror plus its own native catalog entry, retaining original-byte backups and reporting actual output encoding (metadata may become plain JSON). Never patches source projects or splits more clips. Refuses changed copies or a running editor. Catalog readback is not UI-open acceptance.

tools.name: extract_frame
tools.description: Read an actual source frame and return its image to the agent; at is source seconds. Max width 1280.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create an empty editable timeline. Add tracks and clips with the returned project_id.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List service-created projects in ID order; this does not enumerate the user's Jianying drafts.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Inspect revision, layer order, stable clip IDs and paginated edit state. Raw times are integer microseconds.

tools.name: add_track
tools.description: Add a video/audio/text track. Later visual tracks are above earlier tracks; images use video tracks.

tools.name: reorder_track
tools.description: Move a track to a zero-based layer index, preserving all clips. Higher visual indices appear above lower ones.

tools.name: add_video_clip
tools.description: Place video on a video track. start is timeline seconds; source_duration is source seconds before speed.

tools.name: add_audio_clip
tools.description: Place audio on an audio track, including an audio stream from a video file; source_duration is before speed.

tools.name: add_image_clip
tools.description: Place a still image on a video track for an explicit timeline duration in seconds.

tools.name: add_text_clip
tools.description: Add editable native text. Use set_text_style and set_clip_transform to format/place it.

tools.name: import_subtitles
tools.description: Import a UTF-8 SRT as editable native text clips in one atomic operation; overlapping cues are rejected.

tools.name: trim_clip
tools.description: Trim video/audio using absolute source [in,out) seconds. Keep timeline start; duration follows current speed. No ripple.

tools.name: split_clip
tools.description: Split a plain clip at absolute timeline seconds. Original ID stays on the left; return a new right ID.

tools.name: move_clip
tools.description: Move a clip to an absolute timeline start, optionally to another compatible track. No ripple or source trim.

tools.name: remove_clip
tools.description: Remove a service-project clip atomically. ripple=true shifts subsequent clips on the SAME track by its duration; other tracks, sources and saved snapshots stay unchanged. Default keeps gaps.

tools.name: set_clip_duration
tools.description: Set image/text/sticker/effect/filter duration; video/audio duration is controlled through source trimming and speed.

tools.name: set_clip_transform
tools.description: Patch visual transform. Omitted fields stay unchanged. x/y are normalized around center (+y up); scale is a factor.

tools.name: set_clip_speed
tools.description: Set constant video/audio speed; preserve source interval and timeline start, recalculate duration. No ripple.

tools.name: set_clip_audio
tools.description: Set volume (0 mute, 1 original) and fades in timeline seconds. Video supports volume; use an audio clip for fades.

tools.name: set_text_style
tools.description: Patch editable text style and optionally replace text. Omitted style fields stay unchanged; size is native Jianying units.

tools.name: list_transitions
tools.description: Discover exact transition names from the pinned SDK. Catalog membership does not prove local resource availability.

tools.name: set_transition
tools.description: Set an outgoing transition to the next adjacent visual clip. name=null clears it; use list_transitions for exact names.

tools.name: set_keyframes
tools.description: Replace one property's linear keyframes. Point times are relative clip seconds; [] clears that property's keyframes.

tools.name: save_draft
tools.description: Compile an immutable new editable draft snapshot. Does not install it into Jianying or claim UI/export acceptance.

tools.name: export_video
tools.description: Start native MP4 export of a saved snapshot. Returns a durable job_id; poll get_job. Output stays in the workspace.

quality.description: Raw engine numeric option; 0 is default. Other values need version-specific verification.
quality.title: Quality

color_space.description: Raw engine numeric option; 0 is default. Does not certify HDR/color correctness.
color_space.title: Color Space

mp4.description: Raw engine numeric option; 0 is default. Other values need version-specific verification.
mp4.title: Mp4

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Read job state, logs and artifacts. Terminal statuses: succeeded, failed, cancelled, interrupted.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Request cancellation. Keep polling until terminal; cancellation_requested is not a confirmed cancelled state.

tools.name: validate_output
tools.description: Re-probe and fully decode a succeeded job's MP4; check canvas and duration against the saved timeline.

tools.name: list_resources
tools.description: Discover static SDK categories/names, IDs, VIP flags and normalized effect parameters. Not an online library.

tools.name: check_resource_availability
tools.description: Check a catalog entry and bounded local cache name/ID matches in allowed roots. Does not certify rendering.

tools.name: set_text_font
tools.description: Set a catalog font on a text clip; name=null restores the default font.

tools.name: set_text_effect
tools.description: Apply a native fancy-text effect ID inspected from a template; null removes. Resource must be available locally.

tools.name: set_text_bubble
tools.description: Apply a template-inspected text bubble effect/resource pair; both null removes the bubble.

tools.name: set_text_background
tools.description: Replace text background settings (color, rounding, dimensions, offsets); null clears.

tools.name: set_text_shadow
tools.description: Replace text shadow settings; null clears.

tools.name: set_clip_animation
tools.description: Replace one clip animation category using exact catalog name and duration in seconds; name=null clears that category.

tools.name: add_clip_effect
tools.description: Add video/character/filter or audio scene/tone/speech-to-song effect. Returns effect_id for later update/removal.

tools.name: update_clip_effect
tools.description: Replace an effect's category/name/params/intensity while preserving its ID; also edits effect/filter track clips.

tools.name: remove_clip_effect
tools.description: Remove an attached effect by ID. For independent effect/filter clips use remove_clip.

tools.name: set_clip_mask
tools.description: Replace a native mask; null clears. center_x/y are SOURCE PIXELS; size/rect_width are normalized; feather 0..100.

tools.name: set_clip_chroma
tools.description: Replace color-key settings; null clears. Key color is #RRGGBBAA. This is not AI/person segmentation.

tools.name: set_clip_mix_mode
tools.description: Set a catalog blend mode for video/image; null clears.

tools.name: set_clip_background
tools.description: Set blurred/color canvas fill for a bottom video track clip; null clears. Color is #RRGGBBAA.

tools.name: set_clip_crop
tools.description: Replace source rectangle crop; left/top/right/bottom are 0..1, origin top-left. null restores full source.

tools.name: add_sticker_clip
tools.description: Add a native sticker by template-inspected resource ID to a sticker track; resource availability requires native verification.

tools.name: add_effect_clip
tools.description: Add an independent global effect/filter clip. Use an effect track for video/character effects or filter track for filters.

tools.name: import_local_template
tools.description: Copy a local plaintext draft_content JSON into independent template state; source is never edited. Decrypt first if necessary.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List service-owned imported template IDs and revisions; independent of normal editable projects.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Inspect imported template tracks and segment IDs. Timeranges ending _timerange use integer microseconds.

tools.name: inspect_template_resources
tools.description: Extract font/fancy-text/bubble/sticker/effect IDs from a local template; does not download or certify resources.

tools.name: duplicate_template
tools.description: Create an independent copy of service-owned template state, preserving the original template.

tools.name: replace_template_material_by_name
tools.description: Replace a uniquely named template media asset in all referencing segments. Preserves segment source ranges/durations; images use kind=video.

tools.name: replace_template_segment
tools.description: Replace one template media segment using stable IDs. Supports SDK shrink/extend modes; variable-speed segments are rejected.

tools.name: replace_template_text
tools.description: Replace ordinary or multi-part template text while preserving native styling. Use a list for multi-part text templates.

tools.name: import_template_track
tools.description: Copy a video/audio/text track between template workspaces with media/effect references. SDK IDs are preserved; duplicate IDs are rejected.

tools.name: save_template_draft
tools.description: Save a new immutable draft snapshot from template state, compatible with export_video. Does not overwrite source or install into Jianying.

tools.name: convert_local_draft
tools.description: Convert one local draft content file into a NEW workspace artifact using native jy-draftc; never overwrite input. Downgrade requires target_version.

tools.name: check_local_draft
tools.description: Run native self-check against a local draft content sample. Read-only input; does not prove visual correctness.

tools.name: export_local_draft
tools.description: Snapshot and export a local plaintext draft using the persisted job queue. Encrypted drafts must first be decrypted.
